raw_response:
I have only a very small sorghum plot here, so I will keep costs low and do mostly what I know I can manage myself. For a plot this small, buying chemical fertilizer alone is hard unless I share a bag, so I will use manure from home and plant local seed that I trust. I do not usually spray sorghum, and on this plot I depend on the rain, not irrigation. My own labor will be enough, so I will not hire anyone.
